newsitem.title: UK: Russia forms syndicate group for 2.0 bln mark bond.
newsitem.headline: Russia forms syndicate group for 2.0 bln mark bond.

text.p: A syndicate group has been formed for Russia's 2.0 billion mark seven-year bond, joint lead managers Credit Suisse First Boston and Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said. The deal will be free to trade at 0930 GMT.
Senior co-lead managers are Commerzbank, Dresdner Kleinwort Benson, J.P. Morgan and SBC Warburg.

Co-lead managers are ABN AMRO Hoare Govett, Alfa Bank, Banque Bruxelles Lambert, Bank Imperial, Bayerische Hypothekenbank, Bayerische Landesbank, Bayerische Vereinsbank, Daiwa Europe, DG Bank, HSBC Trinkaus, Investmentbank Austria, Merrill Lynch, Bank MFK, Morgan Stanley, Rossiissky Creditbank, Salomon Brothers and Westdeutsche Landesbank.
